newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shangri La to book S$404 mln land surplus.
newsitem.headline: Shangri La to book S$404 mln land surplus.

text.p: Shangri-La Hotel Ltd said on Wednesday its books for the financial year ending December 31, 1996 would show a surplus of Singapore $404.08 million as a result of the revaluation of its properties.

The company said in a statement it had decided to reassess the value of its properties "in view of the significant increase in land values in Singapore over the last few years and as the last revaluation was carried out five years ago".
It said a group of property consultants had assessed the properties in a report dated June 13, 1996 at S$946.91 million.

"The directors have resolved on September 25, 1996 to adopt only the S$404.08 million surplus arising from the revaluation of the land into the company's books with effect from the current financial year ending December 31, 1996," the statement said.
